name: Italian Herb and Cheddar Bread
description:
This loaf is a tribute to old-world flavors, infused with the rustic charm of Italian countryside kitchens.
A medley of Italian herbs—think basil, oregano, thyme, and rosemary—shine through in every slice along with sharp cheddar cheese.

name: Lemon Blueberry Scones
description:
A Tart & Buttery Dream

Soft, buttery, and melt-in-your-mouth delicious, these scones made with fresh blueberries, sourdough starter, and just the right touch of lemon and honey, each bite delivers a perfect balance of tangy and sweet. Forget dry, crumbly scones — these are fluffy, tender, cookie like pastry treats.

name: Cherry Pecan Scones
description:
Tender, buttery scones with tart dried cherries and toasted pecans. The cherries bring a bright, fruity pop while the pecans add warm, nutty depth — a beautiful balance of sweet and earthy. Perfect with morning coffee or afternoon tea.

Contains Dairy and Eggs.

name: Lemon Blueberry Sourdough Cake
description:
Bright, tangy lemon meets bursts of juicy blueberry in this naturally leavened sourdough cake. The starter adds a subtle tang that balances the sweetness, while a thin citrus glaze gives it a glossy finish. It pairs beautifully with morning coffee or afternoon tea.

Contains dairy and eggs.

name: English Muffins
description:
